f157ab8116718fa9.description: About the Role CES - MATLAB® in the Middle East is seeking an Application Engineer for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves working with innovative companies across various industries, including aerospace/defense, oil/gas, communications, automation, and machinery. The Application Engineer will contribute to the marketing and sales of MathWorks’ engineering products and provide technical support to customers. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the marketing and sales of MathWorks’ engineering products. Assist in developing components of software product models and simulations to demonstrate the use of MathWorks’ MATLAB and Simulink products. Develop components of technical engineering demonstrations for MathWorks’ Simulink and MATLAB products to support sales activities. Assist senior team members in engagements with prospective and existing customers to understand workflows and identify relevant MathWorks engineering solutions. Develop application examples and simulations to demonstrate how MathWorks engineering software addresses customer needs. Daily Activities Engage technically with customers to understand project requirements and workflows, then recommend MathWorks technical capabilities. Prepare and deliver technical presentations and demonstrate application examples through onsite visits and seminars. Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to create strategies for different accounts and markets. Execute in-depth technical engagements with customers evaluating MathWorks products. Provide technical support to customers using MATLAB, Simulink, and the entire suite of products. Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience and demonstrate expertise in the following areas: Model-based design using MATLAB and Simulink tools, including modeling, simulating, and analyzing design, testing, and deployment workflows for control design and automation applications across industries such as automotive, aerospace, and robotics. Supporting customers with engineering data analysis workflows using MATLAB and Simulink. Developing and delivering technical product demonstrations to customers and assessing product marketing strategy. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is open to Saudi nationals as part of Saudization efforts.

f177d6ec4d7f264c.description: About the Role Bateel International is seeking an Area Chef to manage kitchen operations across multiple cafés within a designated geographical area in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading kitchen teams to uphold operational standards, contribute to financial success, and ensure customer satisfaction. The Area Chef will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of kitchen management, from service and operations to financial performance and team development. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular visits to cafés to audit compliance with legislative and company requirements, including sanitation, health, and safety, and to monitor customer service and food quality standards. Ensure all Back-of-House checklists are completed according to company and food safety standards. Identify slow-moving inventory items and communicate with Café Managers to implement daily special promotions. Maintain and display up-to-date recipe files. Verify function sheets to ensure timely preparation of food items for special events, meeting quality and quantity standards. Contribute to the development of restaurant budgets and forecasts, and monitor revenues and costs weekly, implementing remedial actions as needed. Supervise assigned areas and costs to maximize food and beverage departmental profit through strict portion control, waste minimization, and utilization of food surpluses. Monitor inventory levels, minimize breakages and miscounts, and review par levels. Ensure adequate raw material supply by checking stock daily and preparing requisitions. Build and motivate a cohesive senior kitchen team, focusing on their welfare, safety, training, and development. Set objectives using annual KPIs, provide regular feedback, and conduct training sessions and appraisals. Prepare and monitor leave planners, ensuring fair scheduling based on business needs. Contribute to the selection, appointment, induction, and training of managers. Motivate, coach, counsel, and discipline managers as necessary to achieve performance standards. Conduct regular health and safety audits, taking prompt action to ensure compliance with brand and company standards, as well as local laws and regulations. Enforce all hygiene, sanitation, and food safety guidelines, including food expiration, fire, and first aid regulations. Ensure kitchens, including machines, furniture, equipment, and utensils, are clean and in working condition. Act as a Bateel brand ambassador, ensuring adherence to grooming guidelines and consistent presentation of food and product quality. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in kitchen operations management, preferably across multiple locations. Demonstrated ability to manage kitchen teams and ensure operational excellence. Strong understanding of financial management, including budgeting, cost control, and inventory management. Proficiency in implementing and enforcing hygiene, health, and safety standards. Experience in staff training, development, and performance management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring regular travel between café locations within the allocated geographical area. The role involves working within a dynamic culinary environment, leading multiple kitchen teams to achieve high standards of service and operational efficiency.

This full-time role is based in the Jeddah office, with daily commutes to Makkah required. The Marketing Specialist will be responsible for developing, implementing, and executing events, site branding, and collateral in collaboration with the Integrated Services Department. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with the Integrated Services team to support commercial objectives. Develop and execute site branding for multiple projects across Makkah. Develop and execute marketing collateral for various projects in Makkah. Manage budgets to ensure maximum value and cost-efficiency. Lead sales events, including Open Houses and Family Galas. Work with performance marketing teams for effective campaign execution. Design and implement social media campaigns to drive sales. Research new marketing platforms and creative mediums to meet commercial goals. Execute Out-of-Home (OOH) campaigns in Makkah. Track and report performance to senior management. Work on special projects as assigned by management. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum of 5 to 10 years of progressive experience in marketing and communications. Prior experience in the real estate, e-commerce, or technology sectors is preferred. Proven track record of leading and managing marketing campaigns and events that drive sales and product adoption. Hands-on experience in campaign management, print production, and competitive audits. Experience in budget management to ensure cost-efficient marketing operations. Required Skills and Knowledge Comprehensive understanding of marketing communication strategies, brand management, and creative processes. Proficiency in campaign management, including platform-specific strategies and tools. Familiarity with digital performance marketing metrics and campaign execution techniques. Understanding of emerging marketing platforms, trends, and technologies. Expertise in creative strategy development and in-house creative team management. Insights into commercial objectives and the role of marketing in achieving them. Work Location This position is based in the Jeddah office, with a requirement for daily commutes to Makkah.

f1ed9550f8a8cb62.description: About Abdul Hadi Abdullah Al-Qahtani & Sons Beverage Company (AQS-PEPSI) Abdul Hadi Abdullah Al-Qahtani & Sons Beverage Company (AQS-PEPSI) is seeking a Pre Seller to join their team in Jazan, Jizan, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for professionals with 2-5 years of experience. Role Purpose The Pre Seller is responsible for direct product sales to various outlets. This role focuses on maintaining strong customer relationships, achieving established sales targets, and ensuring consistent product availability within the market. Key Responsibilities Achieve assigned sales targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Increase product distribution and expand market coverage. Ensure continuous product availability at all customer outlets. Fill and rotate all shelf displays and equipment according to Pepsi-Cola standards. Manage stock levels to ensure ongoing availability. Execute regular stock rotation and control product returns and expiry. Efficiently collect payments and strictly adhere to the company's credit policy. Maintain accurate sales records. Monitor competitor products, pricing, and market activities. Acquire new outlets to drive account growth. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2 to 5 years of relevant experience. Work Environment and Type This is a full-time position based in Jazan, Jizan, Saudi Arabia, within the Abdul Hadi Abdullah Al-Qahtani & Sons Beverage Company (AQS-PEPSI) team. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

f1066eb53bccbe1d.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة بلسم الأفق الطبية عن حاجتها لـ مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الجبيل. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ ومراقبة سير العمل لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه عمليات تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، مع ضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. متابعة عمليات وضع وتتبع موازنات المشاريع وإجراءاتها التعاقدية، وتحديد تكاليفها ومصادر تمويلها. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وعملية الإغلاق، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه الرئيسية. ضمان نقل كافة المعارف والخبرات المتعلقة بالمشروع وتوثيق الوثائق والنماذج والتقارير الخاصة به. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للإدارة العليا والأطراف المعنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لمنهجيات وأدوات إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على إدارة الميزانيات والجداول الزمنية بفعالية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال المقابلة.

f1429f432ca47aed.description: We are looking for an Outbound Officer to join our Supply Chain Operations team at Ninja. In this role, you will verify outbound orders, prepare dispatch documents, and coordinate with the warehouse and transportation teams to ensure orders are loaded onto the correct vehicles and dispatched with the required approvals. Responsibilities Process outbound orders based on dispatch priorities and verify order references, quantities, and route or store details before release. Update order status and confirm required transactions in the Warehouse Management System (WMS). Prepare and verify dispatch documents, manifests, and labels. Keep accurate records of dispatched orders and handovers. Check that orders are staged in the correct areas and support loading checks to match each order to its assigned vehicle. Identify missing, damaged, incomplete, or misrouted orders. Coordinate corrections with the relevant teams and escalate issues that could delay dispatch. Hold orders when required documents or approvals are missing, and follow up on pending orders until the issue is resolved. Follow warehouse safety, product handling, and temperature-control procedures where applicable. Report hazards, damage, or incidents in the loading area. 0–3 years of relevant experience in warehouse operations, logistics, transportation, inventory, or operational support. Fresh graduates with a relevant qualification are welcome to apply. Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Ability to use Microsoft Excel and relevant warehouse or operations systems, such as WMS or ERP. Strong attention to detail, communication, problem-solving, and follow-up skills. Ability to coordinate with different teams in a high-volume distribution center. Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, public holidays, or extended hours as needed. ASCM CLTD or a relevant logistics or transportation certification is a plus. Training in WMS, TMS, fleet management, or transport safety is also an advantage.

f1a85240bf3d4979.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Front Office Supervisor to join its team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves overseeing daily front office operations and ensuring a high standard of guest service. The role focuses on delivering memorable experiences for guests through effective supervision and support of the front office team. Key Responsibilities Supervise front office team members in performing all procedures, including check-ins, check-outs, and guest service delivery. Lead day-to-day team operations, which includes creating schedules, assigning tasks, conducting pre-shift meetings, and providing training and feedback. Manage guest inquiries and concerns directly, and support team members in resolving complex or escalated issues. Monitor guest traffic in the lobby and adjust team coverage to maintain service efficiency. Lead department initiatives and ad-hoc assignments as required. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to supervise and lead a team in a front office environment. Experience in guest service and issue resolution. About Hilton Hilton is a global hospitality leader recognized for its workplace culture. The company focuses on providing exceptional experiences for both guests and team members. Hilton has been repeatedly recognized on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. Career Development Hilton supports career development for its team members, whether they are starting their careers or exploring new opportunities within the hospitality sector.

f1f0fa2bba59cf37.description: About the Role Palo Alto Networks is seeking a Sr Technical Project Manager for the Unit 42 Consulting Operations team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves driving multiple cybersecurity projects concurrently, focusing on Proactive Service, Digital Forensics, and Incident Response engagements. The Senior Technical Project Manager will partner with technical teams, clients, and internal stakeholders to ensure the efficient delivery of mission-critical cybersecurity solutions that optimize client security posture. Unit 42 Consulting Overview Unit 42 Consulting serves as Palo Alto Networks' security advisory team, dedicated to enhancing digital security through high-quality incident response, risk management, and digital forensic services. The team consists of recognized experts with deep technical knowledge in investigations, data breach response, digital forensics, and information security. They provide critical cybersecurity solutions, including effective incident response, attack readiness, and remediation plans, with a focus on long-term support to improve clients’ security posture. Key Responsibilities Manage multiple projects by defining schedules and goals based on Statements of Work (SOWs). Maintain and update accurate project status reports for external clients and customers. Identify project risks and escalate issues to the Engagement Lead to ensure overall client health. Guide technical team members to execute tasks, accomplish objectives, and monitor progress to completion. Support the delivery of high-quality cybersecurity solutions to consistently exceed client expectations. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the Professional Services team’s technical skill sets. Partner with consulting leadership to identify and address staffing needs for each project. Develop strong, trusted partnerships with internal and external stakeholders across all engagements. Collaborate with Engagement Leads to ensure projects strictly adhere to budget and time frame guidelines. Identify opportunities to increase client satisfaction and deepen relationships alongside the Engagement Lead. Navigate customer expectations and manage conflicts effectively to ensure successful project outcomes. Required Qualifications 7+ years of professional experience in Project Management within Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, or Artificial Intelligence. Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience. Proven ability to lead multiple large-scale projects, create plans, and ensure on-time execution. Demonstrated capacity to work autonomously, prioritize tasks, and solve problems with meticulous attention to detail. Strong ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of client organizations. Flexibility to work nights, weekends, and holidays as required by incident response engagements. High level of diplomacy and ability to maintain strict confidentiality. Preferred Qualifications Previous direct client or customer consulting experience in a technical environment. PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent industry credential. Strong proficiency with project management tools such as Google Suite, Asana, and Clarizen. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role operates within a dynamic technical environment, necessitating adaptability and a client-focused approach to project delivery.

f17236b97c1c3ea4.description: أخصائية إدارة حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي | زهرة البنفسج نبحث عن أخصائية تدير حسابات زهرة البنفسج، وتصنع محتوى يوميًا يعرّف العميلات بمنتجات العناية بالشعر ويساعدهن على اختيار المنتج المناسب ويشجعهن على الشراء. ساعات العمل 6 ساعات يوميًا. المهام اليومية تصميم المنشورات والستوري وإعداد ونشر المقاطع القصيرة بما يتناسب مع هوية المتجر. تخصيص محتوى يومي لمنتج واحد، وشرح فوائده وطريقة استخدامه ولأي نوع شعر يناسب، مع إضافة رابط الطلب. التفاعل مع العميلات والرد على الرسائل والتعليقات، ومساعدتهن في اختيار المنتجات حسب احتياجهن. تشجيع العميلات على الشراء يوميًا بأفكار متنوعة، مثل عرض طريقة الاستخدام، ومشاركة تجارب العميلات بإذنهن، والتعريف بالعروض المتاحة. إعداد خطة محتوى أسبوعية ومتابعة أداء المنشورات لمعرفة أكثر المواضيع التي تتفاعل معها العميلات. المهارات المطلوبة أسلوب كتابة واضح وجذاب، ومهارة في التصميم وتحرير المقاطع القصيرة، والقدرة على تنظيم المحتوى والنشر بانتظام والتعامل مع العميلات بلباقة. يُفضّل وجود خبرة في إدارة حسابات المتاجر الإلكترونية أو العلامات المتخصصة في العناية والجمال.

f1dbdd59eefe8fa1.description: نحن في شركة ماتريكس للاستشارات الهندسية (احدى شركات خطوة الثروة للاستثمار ) نبحث عن طاقة مبيعات استثنائية، يمتلك لغة الإقناع، الحضور الراقي، والقدرة الفذة على بناء شراكات استراتيجية وإغلاق الصفقات الكبرى مع كبار العملاء وتقديم وبيع الخدمات الهندسية من رخص بناء واشراف مباني وتصاميم إذا كنت تمتلك مهارة التفاوض الحاد، وشغف تحقيق الأرقام القياسية، وتطمح لأن تكون جزءاً من بيئة استثمارية صاعدة بقوة — فهذه الفرصة لك. المسمى الوظيفي: أخصائي مبيعات المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية: جذب وإغلاق الصفقات: استقطاب مستثمرين جدد، بناء علاقات استراتيجية قوية معهم، وتحويل الفرص إلى صفقات استثمارية وعقارية ناجحة. التمثيل الاحترافي: تقديم عروض تقديمية (Presentations) احترافية لمشاريع المجموعة والفرص الاستثمارية المطروحة بأسلوب مقنع ومؤثر. التواصل الذكي: إدارة النقاشات المعقدة مع أصحاب رؤوس الأموال وكبار العملاء بكفاءة وثقة عالية. تحقيق المستهدفات (KPIs): الالتزام بتحقيق الأهداف البيعية الشهرية والربعسنوية بما يتوافق مع خطط التوسع والنمو للمجموعة. اقتناص الفرص: رصد متطلبات السوق الاستثماري واحتياجات المستثمرين وتقديمها كحلول تنافسية. المتطلبات والشروط: الخبرة: خبرة لا تقل عن (2-3 سنوات) في مبيعات العقارات الفاخرة، أو الأصول الاستثمارية، أو القطاع المالي (يفضّل من لديه شبكة علاقات قائمة مع مستثمرين). مهارات التواصل: متحدث لبق، يمتلك مهارات إقناع عالية، وحضور شخصي قوي ومؤثر. المهارات الشخصية: الجرأة في التفاوض، القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط، الذكاء الاجتماعي، والتركيز العالي على تحقيق النتائج (Results-driven). ما نقدمه لك: بنية عمولات ومكافآت تحفيزية عالية جداً (ترتبط ارتباطاً مباشراً بحجم الصفقات المغلقة لضمان عوائد مالية ممتازة). بيئة عمل احترافية، ديناميكية، وداعمة للنمو والتطور المهني. فرص حقيقية للترقي وتطوير المسار الوظيفي داخل المجموعة. طريقة التقديم: إذا كنت تملك الكفاءة وتثق قدرتك على جلب الصفقات وصنع الفارق، نرجو إرسال السيرة الذاتية (CV) مع نبذة قصيرة أو مقطع صوتي تعريفي (إن أمكن) يوضح أبرز إنجازاتك السابقة في المبيعات عبر: البريد الإلكتروني: i@********************

f1a7efaff4804c38.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مصادر الانشاء للمقاولات عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الرياض، وتحديداً في الخرج. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان الأداء الفعال للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية من خلال تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بدقة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة اللازمة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقاً للجداول الزمنية المحددة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير التكاليف والمواد اللازمة للصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الصيانة الميكانيكية ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة مصادر الانشاء للمقاولات، ويقع مقر العمل في الخرج، الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة المجدولة وغير المجدولة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية ممتازة في صيانة وإصلاح المعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية بدقة ووضوح. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. مهارات تنظيمية لمتابعة برامج الصيانة الوقائية. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل ملتزم في قطاع المقاولات. لم يتم الكشف عن الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

f11c49e4406ce8df.description: About the Role Pasqal is seeking a Quantum Solutions Lead to build, grow, and manage use case development and solutions engineering activities in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, with operations extending to Thuwal and Makkah. The role involves developing quantum applications for Pasqal technology with clients and partners both regionally and globally, requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Grow and manage the KSA Quantum Solutions team by attracting talented researchers, engineers, and developers, providing guidance and support, and ensuring project progression. The team will include multidisciplinary expertise in optimization, chemistry, and machine learning. Identify opportunities and lead project development with customers and partners, selecting projects aligned with existing solutions, algorithm development roadmap, and hardware capabilities. Collaborate with Business Development to engage with customers' technical and domain teams during the pre-project phase, assessing pain points, and scoping them into use case development projects. Work closely with Product Management, Sales, and Marketing teams to transition one-off projects into repeatable products. Ensure proper knowledge transfer with worldwide Quantum Solutions teams. Collaborate with Quantum Applications teams on the usage and development of Pasqal quantum software stack libraries. Represent Pasqal Quantum Applications within the local and regional technical and scientific ecosystem. Maintain regular technological watch. Engage in inventive activities related to Pasqal applications and products, creating a strong IP portfolio in quantum applications and filing patents. Required Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Environment and Benefits This is a permanent, full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role offers the opportunity to join a dynamic and collaborative international team within a growing international company. Pasqal is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. Recruitment Process An interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 minutes). The technician will provide technical assistance to existing customer personnel as covered under approved agreements. Key Responsibilities Perform maintenance and maintainability demonstrations for customers. Prepare and maintain records related to equipment failures. Participate in on-the-job training (OJT) programs and assist in enforcing safety policies, procedures, and standards. Repair and perform direct maintenance (DM) on military heavy/light vehicles, vehicle-mounted actuators, forklifts, and all hydraulic cylinders and valves. Set up and operate machine tools such as lathes, milling machines, and/or grinders. Perform test, inspection, and repair on hydraulic systems, verifying serviceability against prescribed standards. Execute adjustments and alignments for optimum performance. Identify faulty work practices and demonstrate proper maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair procedures and techniques. Provide on-site maintenance assistance as required. Complete maintenance and supply forms and prepare Patriot Field Reports (PFRs). Conduct assembly, disassembly, re-assembly, fabrication, repair, and/or inspection of electronic, electrical, and mechanical systems, chassis, and cables. Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience. Basic job knowledge in the use of engineering documentation, schematics, general-purpose commercial test equipment, and common tools. Ability to follow basic work routines and standards through OJT for troubleshooting, fault isolation, and repair of Patriot Launching Station (LS) and AMG hydraulics, pneumatics, and mast structures. Experience in troubleshooting, fault isolation, repair, test, and checkout. General knowledge of maintenance workshop procedures. Work Environment This position is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and involves supporting Royal Saudi Air Defense Forces (RSADF) systems. The role requires collaboration with existing customer personnel and adherence to safety policies and procedures.

f163b76564c9f0e4.description: About the Role UNOX, a market leader in professional ovens, is seeking a Sales Engineer (Food Industry Applications) to join its Roboqbo Business Unit in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The position involves driving new business opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and supporting commercial growth. Plan and deliver product demonstrations, application tests, and Individual Cooking Experience (ICE) sessions to showcase Roboqbo's capabilities and demonstrate the value of its solutions in industrial food production processes. Represent Roboqbo at industrial food exhibitions, trade fairs, industry events, technical workshops, and customer demonstrations. Maintain accurate activity, opportunity, and customer reports through the company CRM system. Background in food production, food technology, culinary applications, or food processing, with a good understanding of industrial food production processes. f1749197033cd8a0.description: About the Role DP World is seeking a Manager, Business Process Improvement & Digitization to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on enhancing customer-related processes through innovative and advanced digital technologies. This involves leveraging digital services, EDI, API integration, and workflow management to achieve complete automation. The role is critical in sustaining DP World's leading market position by ensuring operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Continuously improve business processes using innovation and advanced technologies to eliminate waste, reduce costs, and enhance productivity, customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention. Identify and implement new processes with full automation to meet evolving business and customer demands. Collaborate with Customers, IT, Operations, Customs, and other authorities to manage process enhancements and system developments, ensuring alignment with requirements and timely implementation. f1bb02daf84b2dee.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Metallurgy Engineer to join the Mechanical Services Shops in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing materials and metallurgical engineering support for component fabrication, repair, qualification, and failure prevention. The Mechanical Services Shops are responsible for the repair of rotating and static equipment and the fabrication of components. Role Responsibilities The Metallurgy Engineer will be responsible for establishing material requirements, evaluating microstructure and properties, selecting processing routes, resolving degradation mechanisms, and ensuring materials are fit for oil and gas service. Key responsibilities include: Material Selection & Specification: Selecting metals, alloys, heat treatments, coatings, and acceptance requirements based on strength, toughness, temperature, corrosion, wear, and manufacturability. Material Characterization: Planning and interpreting metallography, microstructure, hardness, tensile, impact, fracture, corrosion, and coating examinations to confirm material condition. Fabrication & Repair Support: Providing metallurgical control for casting, forging, welding, cladding, additive manufacturing, machining, heat treatment, and repair qualification. Failure & Damage Analysis: Investigating cracking, corrosion, erosion, embrittlement, creep, fatigue, wear, overheating, and fabrication defects; identifying root cause and recommending corrective action. Technical Governance: Developing material specifications and test plans, reviewing certificates and deviations, qualifying procedures, issuing technical reports, and mentoring personnel. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should meet the following requirements: A Bachelor's degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or Materials Science from a recognized and approved program is required. A Master's degree or PhD is preferred. At least 15 years of metallurgical or materials-engineering experience, including a minimum of 8 years supporting industrial manufacturing, repair, or failure analysis. Strong expertise in ferrous and nonferrous metallurgy, phase transformations, heat treatment, welding metallurgy, corrosion, fracture, fatigue, and wear is necessary. Demonstrated experience with metallography, microstructure evaluation, material characterization, mechanical testing, and failure-analysis reporting is required. Ability to translate service conditions and damage mechanisms into material, process, inspection, and acceptance requirements is essential. ASM professional materials credentials, AMPP/NACE corrosion training, or equivalent recognized certification is preferred. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time Metallurgy Engineer position in Saudi Arabia.

f1ce5e0aaa1f84cb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث كيان الإجادة للمحاماة والاستشارات القانونية عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ ومراقبة إجراءات الموارد البشرية، بما في ذلك إدارة دوام الموظفين والإجازات، وتحديث بيانات الموظفين، والتعامل مع الاستفسارات والشكاوى بمهنية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم المتنوعة، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة بفعالية. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع البيانات مثل الترقيات والدورات التدريبية والرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم قوي لإجراءات وأنظمة الموارد البشرية وسياسات الإجازات والحضور. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تحديث البيانات وحفظ الوثائق. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية جيدة. بيئة العمل سيعمل أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية بدوام كامل في مقر الشركة بالرياض، ضمن بيئة مهنية تدعم تطبيق أفضل ممارسات الموارد البشرية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في كيان الإجادة للمحاماة والاستشارات القانونية.

f1d66bc5d3ab3070.description: Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Districts and Parks Landscape Manager to lead the operation and maintenance of assigned landscapes, green spaces and parks across Qiddiya City. This is an opportunity to combine horticultural expertise with operational leadership, creating healthy, well-presented outdoor environments that are safe and ready for public use. What you’ll do Manage landscape maintenance: Deliver planned, preventive and reactive maintenance programmes, coordinating contractor resources, materials and equipment across multiple sites. Maintain plant health and quality: Oversee the care of trees, palms, shrubs, groundcovers, turf and seasonal planting, including pruning, soil improvement, nutrition, replacement and integrated pest management. Drive water-efficient irrigation: Coordinate irrigation schedules, controller operation, leak response and system maintenance, monitoring consumption and addressing abnormal water use. Assure service performance: Inspect sites, verify completed work, monitor KPIs and complaint resolution, and drive corrective action where standards are not met. Support safe, welcoming parks: Identify landscape hazards, coordinate specialist tree assessments where needed, and refer defects affecting paths, furniture, play equipment and lighting to the responsible asset owners. Support handover and readiness: Contribute to maintainability reviews, snagging and verification of asset records, irrigation drawings, maintenance manuals, warranties and establishment obligations. Plan for operational pressures: Coordinate landscape protection and recovery around events, high-footfall periods, extreme weather and irrigation interruptions. Maintain financial and operational control: Monitor allocated budgets, verify contractor submissions and maintain accurate CAFM work orders, inspection records, planting inventories and defect logs. What you’ll bring A bachelor’s degree in Horticulture, Landscape Management, Agriculture, Landscape Architecture or a related discipline . Equivalent relevant professional qualifications supported by substantial operational experience may also be considered. Experience maintaining district landscapes, public parks, mixed-use developments or comparable high-visibility estates, preferably in arid environments. Practical knowledge of arid-climate horticulture, tree and palm care, turf management, soils, plant health and water-efficient irrigation. Demonstrated experience in contractor coordination, maintenance planning, site inspections, seasonal programmes, operational handovers, defect resolution and cost control within occupied public environments. The ability to interpret landscape and irrigation drawings, use CAFM and reporting tools, and communicate effectively across operational teams and service providers. A practical commitment to health, safety and environmental requirements, including safe working practices and protection of public access during maintenance activities.

f12166d1b1c3e6b6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إنجاز ديل لتحصيل الديون عن سكرتير قانوني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري للمهنيين القانونيين، مع التركيز على إدارة الوثائق والمراسلات القانونية، وتنظيم جداول المحكمة، وحفظ الأرشيف. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع وأرشفة المراسلات والوثائق الخاصة بملفات القضايا، وحفظ الأرشيف وفقًا لسياسات الاستبقاء المعتمدة. تنظيم المكتبات القانونية والمحافظة عليها لضمان سهولة الوصول إلى المعلومات. مساعدة المحامين والمهنيين القانونيين في البحث عن المعلومات، بما في ذلك المنشورات القانونية والأنظمة وقرارات المحكمة المتعلقة بالقضايا المعلقة. إدارة مراسلات الإجراءات القانونية والعقود والنزاعات القانونية، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. تنظيف المعدات وأداء الصيانة الأساسية، والإبلاغ عن أي أعطال فنية، والاحتفاظ بسجل للأعمال المنجزة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منهجي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال السكرتارية القانونية أو دور إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الوثائق القانونية وإدارة المراسلات بكفاءة. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة والقدرة على إدارة الأولويات المتعددة. المهارات المطلوبة إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المكتبية. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية قوية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع المهام. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة مهنية داعمة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

f1925f0fa32149d6.description: About the Role Hays is seeking an experienced Security Baselines Architect to join a major cybersecurity architecture and governance program. This contract position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working within a highly regulated enterprise environment. The role focuses on enhancing the organization's security posture through secure configuration management and continuous security improvement. Role Purpose and Context The Security Baselines Architect will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and enforcing Minimum Security Baselines (MSBs), system hardening standards, and configuration compliance controls. This scope covers enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, databases, operating systems, and security technologies, playing a critical part in compliance monitoring and security posture improvement. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain enterprise Minimum Security Baselines (MSBs) and hardening standards. Define secure configuration standards for Windows Servers and Workstations, Linux Operating Systems, Network Devices (Firewalls, Routers, Switches), Databases, Cloud Platforms, and Security Technologies. Establish and maintain security hardening requirements aligned with industry best practices. Perform baseline gap assessments and configuration reviews across enterprise environments. Conduct configuration compliance assessments and identify deviations from approved baselines. Monitor configuration drift and coordinate remediation activities with technical teams. Review system and platform configurations against security standards and approved baselines. Leverage CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs, and vendor security configuration guidelines to define security requirements. Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, network, security, and architecture teams to implement secure configurations. Support security audits, compliance initiatives, and cybersecurity assessments. Develop documentation, guidelines, and procedures related to enterprise hardening standards. Contribute to security architecture reviews and cybersecurity governance activities. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in security architecture and governance. Demonstrated experience in developing and enforcing security baselines and hardening standards. Familiarity with highly regulated enterprise environments is required. Work Type and Location This is a contract position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires on-site presence to support a major cybersecurity architecture and governance program.

f1ee7146f8c76723.description: ملخص الوظيفة يتولى موظف عمليات التخليص الجمركي مسؤولية تجهيز ومراجعة المستندات الجمركية، وإدخال بيانات المنتجات والبضائع في الأنظمة والمنصات الإلكترونية ذات العلاقة، ومتابعة إجراءات التخليص الجمركي حتى إتمام الإفراج عن الشحنات.كما تشمل الوظيفة التنسيق المستمر مع المخلص الجمركي المرخص، ومتابعة المعاملات الجمركية، والتأكد من اكتمال وصحة البيانات والمستندات المطلوبة لتجنب التأخير والغرامات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدخال بيانات المنتجات والأصناف وتفاصيل الشحنات في منصة فسح والأنظمة الجمركية ذات العلاقة.تجهيز ومراجعة المستندات الجمركية، بما في ذلك الفواتير التجارية (Commercial Invoice)، وقوائم التعبئة (Packing List)، وبوالص الشحن (Bill of Lading)، وشهادات المنشأ (Certificate of Origin).مراجعة بيانات المنتجات وتصنيفها الجمركي وتحديد أكواد النظام المنسق (HS Code) بالتنسيق مع المخلص الجمركي.متابعة إجراءات التخليص الجمركي للشحنات البحرية والجوية والبرية.التنسيق مع المخلصين الجمركيين وشركات الشحن والموانئ والجهات الحكومية ذات العلاقة.متابعة طلبات الفسح والموافقات والشهادات المطلوبة للمنتجات حسب طبيعة كل شحنة.التأكد من اكتمال وصحة المستندات والبيانات قبل تقديمها للجهات المختصة.متابعة حالة الشحنات والمعاملات الجمركية والعمل على معالجة أي ملاحظات أو نواقص.حفظ وتنظيم الملفات والسجلات الجمركية إلكترونياً ومتابعة تحديثها.مراجعة الرسوم الجمركية والضرائب والتكاليف المتعلقة بالشحنات ومطابقتها مع المستندات.إعداد التقارير الدورية عن حالة الشحنات والمعاملات الجمركية.متابعة التحديثات المتعلقة بالإجراءات والأنظمة الجمركية في المملكة العربية السعودية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة شهادة دبلوم أو بكالوريوس في إدارة الأعمال أو اللوجستيات أو سلاسل الإمداد أو أي تخصص ذي صلة.خبرة عملية من سنة إلى 3 سنوات في مجال التخليص الجمركي أو العمليات اللوجستية أو الاستيراد والتصدير.خبرة في استخدام منصة فسح (FASAH) تعتبر ميزة أساسية.معرفة جيدة بالمستندات والإجراءات الجمركية في المملكة العربية السعودية.معرفة بأكواد HS Code وتصنيف المنتجات تعتبر ميزة إضافية.خبرة في التعامل مع الشحنات البحرية والمستندات الخاصة بها.إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج Microsoft Office، وخاصة Excel. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل عند إدخال البيانات ومراجعة المستندات.مهارات جيدة في التنظيم وإدارة الوقت ومتابعة المعاملات.القدرة على التواصل والتنسيق مع المخلصين الجمركيين وشركات الشحن.القدرة على العمل تحت ضغط ومتابعة عدة شحنات في الوقت نفسه.مهارات حل المشكلات والتعامل مع الملاحظات الجمركية.إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية قراءة وكتابة.إجادة اللغة الصينية تعتبر ميزة إضافية وليست شرطاً. بيئة العمل مقر العمل في جدة المملكة العربية السعودية، ضمن فريق العمليات في شركة سمسمه النجوم. تتطلب الوظيفة شخصاً منظماً ودقيقاً ومبادراً، لديه القدرة على متابعة الإجراءات الجمركية والتنسيق مع مختلف الأطراف لضمان إنجاز معاملات الشحنات بكفاءة وسرعة.ملاحظة: الوظيفة إدارية وتشغيلية لمساندة أعمال التخليص الجمركي، ولا يُشترط الحصول على ترخيص مخلص جمركي.

f1ef14e0743d73f4.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة: نقدم حلول وخدمات الفحوصات الطبية المؤسسية المعتمدة للموظفين، ونستهدف تسهيل إصدار وتجديد الوثائق الرسمية للشركات والأنشطة التجارية، مثل فحوصات الشهادات الصحية (بلدي) وغيرها من الفحوصات المهنية المطلوبة تنظيمياً. المهام الوظيفية: بناء التنفيذ والتسويق الميداني واستقطاب عملاء جدد من قطاع الشركات، المطاعم، الكافيهات، والمنشآت التجارية. تنفيذ زيارات ميدانية مباشرة لأصحاب القرار ومسؤولي التشغيل والموارد البشرية لعرض حزم الفحوصات الطبية والشهادات الصحية. بناء شبكة علاقات قوية وإقناع العملاء بالخدمات لضمان تلبية احتياجاتهم التنظيمية. إدارة دورة بيع الخدمات الميدانية من تقديم العروض وحتى إتمام وتوقيع العقود واتفاقيات التعاون. تحقيق المستهدفات البيعية الشهرية والربعية لتوسيع حصتنا السوقية. المتطلبات والمهارات: خبرة لا تقل عن (1-3 سنوات) في المبيعات الميدانية أو تطوير الأعمال الموجهة للشركات (B2B)، ويفضل من لديه خلفية في قطاع الخدمات الطبية، الأغذية، أو الأنشطة التجارية. مهارات عالية في التواصل، التفاوض، والإقناع وعرض الخدمات بأسلوب احترافي. القدرة على العمل الميداني وإدارة جدول الزيارات بكفاءة عالية. إجادة اللغة العربية والانجليزية بشكل ممتاز.

f1faf7838a996ef4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة خالد علي الفردان للمقاولات عن كاتب علاقات حكومية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى توفير الدعم اللازم لتخليص المعاملات الحكومية ومتابعتها، بالإضافة إلى استكمال المتطلبات الإجرائية والمستندية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بالوثائق والشروط المطلوبة لتخليص المعاملات، وتأمينها وتوفيرها بفعالية وسرعة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. تحديث واستكمال جميع متطلبات النماذج والمستندات والإجراءات الحكومية بما يتوافق مع القوانين واللوائح المنظمة للعمل. تنفيذ التعليمات المتعلقة بسرية التعاملات والسجلات، والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. حفظ الوثائق وتبويبها وترتيبها بناءً على الممارسات المعتمدة. استقبال استفسارات الموظفين والإجابة عليها، ومتابعة معاملاتهم بالتنسيق مع الوحدات الخارجية المعنية، وإحاطتهم بكافة المستجدات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الإجراءات الحكومية والمتطلبات الإدارية. المهارات المطلوبة الأمانة والإتقان في أداء المهام الموكلة. مهارات تنظيمية عالية في حفظ الوثائق وتبويبها. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع الوحدات الداخلية والخارجية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق يدعم العمليات الإدارية المتعلقة بالعلاقات الحكومية ومعاملات الموظفين. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

f1fd578a66927c79.description: About the Role Alpin is seeking a Structural Engineer for major buildings and infrastructure projects in Riyadh. This full-time role involves providing structural engineering input across design and construction stages, with a focus on technical assurance, multidisciplinary coordination, and practical resolution of structural issues. Candidates should have a minimum of 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Perform and review structural engineering analyses, calculations, and design documentation for buildings and infrastructure projects. Review structural drawings, calculations, technical reports, and design submissions for completeness, coordination, and technical compliance. f1947bcd121c88b8.description: About the Role The Zakat & Tax Operations Audit Director will manage the Zakat & Tax Operations Audit function at the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing audit planning, intervention, and reporting to ensure compliance with relevant policies, processes, procedures, and guidelines in an independent manner. The position requires 8-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the development of the Operational Audit business plan, ensuring alignment with ZATCA's strategy. Develop the operational plan for Zakat & Tax Operations Audit in line with the Operational Audit business plan and Internal Audit strategic plan. Implement plans and provide input to achieve Zakat & Tax Operations Audit goals that support ZATCA’s overall strategic plans. Discuss Zakat & Tax Operations Audit budgeting requirements with top management and provide input to the budgeting process. Ensure effective utilization of the Zakat & Tax Operations Audit budget and report accurately on progress and challenges. Investigate and propose initiatives that result in positive financial impact for Zakat & Tax Operations Audit and mitigate financial and operational risks. Audit Planning and Execution Manage the development of Zakat & Tax Operations internal audit guidelines, methodologies, and related templates, ensuring alignment with internal audit QA guidelines and international standards. Recommend cooperation and liaison with external auditors for specific audits. Manage the development of the Zakat & Tax Operations internal annual audit plan, specifying functions subject to audits, audit frequency, and schedule, considering resource availability and targeting key risks. Provide input to the developed Zakat & Tax Operations audit program/RCM, including audit scope, key assessment areas, audit dates, and focal points, ensuring related functions are notified. Confirm Zakat & Tax Operations audit objectives, scope, and methodology with the concerned function’s focal point. Manage Zakat & Tax Operations internal audit interventions, ensuring review of documents, records, systems, and practices, follow-up on improvements, detection of non-conformities, investigation of irregularities, and identification of improvement areas. Develop individual performance objectives, provide necessary support, evaluate team performance, and provide regular feedback. Establish a high-performance working environment and promote ZATCA values. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority. The role involves working independently to ensure compliance and uphold internal audit standards.

f19238e09c30403a.description: About the Role Futu Holdings is seeking a Head of Dealing to oversee the dealing function for moomoo across three daily shifts. This full-time leadership position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires a hands-on approach to managing staffing, risk discipline, and critical trading incidents. The role involves ultimate responsibility for the overall performance and continuity of operations. Department Leadership and Operations Manage operating capacity and ensure complete dealing coverage across all three daily shifts, including creating, approving, and maintaining rotas aligned with Saudi and * market hours and expected trading volumes. Plan for leave, absence, market holidays, * Daylight Saving transitions, peak volume, and product events, implementing backup rosters, cross-training, and succession coverage. Hold Senior Dealers accountable for attendance checks and shift readiness, addressing any coverage shortfalls by reassigning resources, activating backup, or providing direct desk support. Lead workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, coaching, performance reviews, and development for Senior Dealers and Dealers, setting clear expectations and escalation ownership. Lead the response to high-impact trading incidents, execution errors, client escalations, and market or platform outages, directing containment, management updates, and post-incident remediation. f1e3a2553223be33.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحلول الذكية المتقدمة عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة الشاملة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تقديم حلول التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء عالية الجودة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة الحلول الذكية المتقدمة في هذا الدور، يرجى التقديم مباشرة. سيتم مناقشة تفاصيل الراتب خلال عملية المقابلة.

f1e6e2f599357f69.description: About the Role Premium Food Company is seeking a Quality Manager (Meat Processing) to oversee food safety, quality control, and regulatory compliance at its meat processing facility. This full-time role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and is critical for ensuring products meet company standards, customer requirements, and legal regulations. Liaise with regulatory bodies, certification agencies, and key customers on quality-related issues. Promote a strong food safety and continuous improvement culture across all departments. Conduct training for production staff on hygiene, sanitation, and product handling. f165bd4c6243e37b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إكسبيرتس كير عن مساعد طبيب أسنان للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم طبيب الأسنان في تقديم رعاية عالية الجودة للمرضى، من خلال تحضير المواد والأدوات اللازمة وضمان بيئة عمل منظمة ومعقمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال المرضى وإجلاسهم على كرسي طب الأسنان، وتوثيق بياناتهم الشخصية في الملفات المخصصة. تنظيف وتطهير وتعقيم الأجهزة والأدوات المستخدمة في عيادة الأسنان، بالإضافة إلى فحص وتشغيل كرسي الأسنان. تحضير المواد السنية المطلوبة وخلط الحشوات المؤقتة والدائمة للأسنان، وخلط المواد العازلة. مساعدة طبيب الأسنان أثناء الإجراءات العلاجية، ومناولته الأدوات والمواد، وسحب اللعاب. فحص أدوات ومعدات العمل، وتنظيفها، وتخزين مواد الأسنان وفقًا لظروف التخزين المناسبة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المهام التشغيلية يتولى مساعد طبيب الأسنان مسؤولية تحضير المواد السنية وخلط الحشوات، بالإضافة إلى مناولة طبيب الأسنان الأدوات والمواد حسب الحاجة. كما يشمل الدور تفقد الأجهزة والمعدات والأدوات المستخدمة، وصيانتها، وتخزينها بشكل صحيح لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال مساعد طبيب الأسنان أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. بيئة العمل يعمل مساعد طبيب الأسنان ضمن عيادة أسنان في الطائف، مكة المكرمة، في بيئة تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير النظافة والتعقيم. يتطلب الدور التعاون الفعال مع طبيب الأسنان وفريق العمل لضمان تقديم أفضل رعاية للمرضى. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة إكسبيرتس كير في هذا الدور، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الراتب والخطوات التالية.

This full-time role is responsible for the technical design, execution, coordination, and commissioning of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems for industrial refrigeration, cold storage, and controlled environment projects. The position requires strong expertise in refrigeration systems, HVAC, electrical power distribution, fire protection, and plumbing to ensure efficient and compliant project execution. Key Responsibilities Supervise the installation of ammonia and Freon refrigeration systems for industrial and cold storage applications, including compressors, evaporators, condensers, expansion valves, and liquid receivers. Oversee the proper installation of high- and low-pressure refrigerant piping systems and implement appropriate defrost systems (hot gas, electric, water). Perform pressure testing and leak detection using approved industry practices, ensuring compliance with IIAR, ASHRAE, SFDA, and refrigeration safety regulations. Supervise HVAC installations for cold rooms, blast freezers, and processing areas, ensuring proper airflow, humidity control, and temperature uniformity. Oversee the installation of air curtains, insulated doors, and dehumidification systems. Manage the installation of transformers, switchgear, MCC panels, and distribution boards for electrical systems. Supervise the installation and commissioning of PLC systems and VFDs, and oversee emergency power systems including generators and UPS. Ensure proper earthing and bonding of electrical systems and implement SCADA and remote monitoring systems. Supervise glycol piping and brine cooling systems, oversee defrost drainage systems, and conduct flow testing for cooling tower and condenser water systems. Ensure compliance with plumbing codes and water treatment standards. Implement ammonia gas leak detection systems, conduct risk assessments, and establish emergency response procedures. Review shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements, and coordinate with civil, structural, and architectural teams. Manage subcontractors and ensure compliance with schedules and specifications, implementing BIM coordination using Revit MEP and Navisworks. Conduct performance testing and energy efficiency verification, perform air balancing and functional testing of systems, and support third-party testing and optimization. Train operators and submit as-built documents, O&M manuals, and certificates upon project handover. Internal and External Collaboration The Project Engineer will collaborate internally with Project Teams, Procurement Teams, Store Teams, and Sales Teams. Externally, the role involves interaction with Clients/Consultants, Vendors, Subcontractors, and Regulatory Authorities & Environmental Safety Inspectors. Qualifications and Requirements 3-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong expertise in refrigeration systems, HVAC, electrical power distribution, fire protection, and plumbing. Familiarity with local authority approval processes for industrial refrigeration projects. Valid driving license and willingness to travel.

f175b824e51fe0fb.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع البلاستيك الاهلي عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، متابعة الإيرادات، وتدقيق الحسابات المصرفية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، ويهدف إلى ضمان دقة السجلات المالية والامتثال للإجراءات المحاسبية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المخصصة. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. المهام التفصيلية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة لمواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في المجال. ضمان حفظ الوثائق والتقارير المالية بشكل منظم ويمكن الرجوع إليه بسهولة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. فهم جيد للمبادئ والإجراءات المحاسبية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية وتحليل البيانات. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصنع البلاستيك الاهلي. يتميز المصنع ببيئة عمل منظمة تدعم النمو المهني وتطبيق أفضل الممارسات المحاسبية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن.

f18325d9accfea1b.description: Own the health, security, and continuity of the organisation's core Microsoft platform: Exchange Server 2019 (on-premises) in hybrid with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, and the identity and email-security layers that sit on top of them. The role helps maintain reliable corporate messaging, mailbox availability, and identity services in a multi-site business environment. KEY Responsibilities Core: Microsoft Exchange (on-premises + hybrid) • Install, configure, administer, and upgrade Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 on-premises; apply cumulative updates and security patches on a controlled schedule. • Run and maintain Exchange Hybrid with Microsoft 365: hybrid configuration, free/busy, cross-premises mail flow, and directory synchronisation health. • Execute mailbox migrations (on-prem to/from Exchange Online) with zero-data-loss cutovers and a tested rollback for each wave. • Manage mailbox lifecycle, distribution and shared mailboxes, mail flow, transport rules, send/receive connectors, and certificate lifecycle (issuance, renewal, binding) with no lapsed-certificate outages. • Design, build, and maintain Database Availability Groups (DAG) for Exchange high availability; own failover testing and quorum health. • Diagnose and resolve complex mail-delivery, queue, performance, and availability problems using message tracking, protocol logs, and transport diagnostics. Core: Active Directory & Group Policy • Perform advanced Active Directory administration: domain services, sites, trusts, OU design, delegation, user authentication, and permissions. • Design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimise Group Policy (GPO): scope, precedence, security filtering, and drift control. • Administer and maintain DNS and DHCP as authoritative infrastructure services for the estate. • Own AD replication health, security hardening (privileged accounts, tiering), and disaster-recovery readiness for the directory (backup, forest/domain recovery runbook, tested restore). Core: Email Security • Administer the enterprise email-security gateway/solution: anti-spam, anti-phishing, malware protection, content filtering, quarantine management, and policy tuning. • Own the sender-authentication stack (SPF, DKIM, and DMARC) from monitoring through enforcement, and manage mail routing and inbound/outbound threat protection. • Investigate email-borne threats and phishing incidents with Information Security; tune policies to cut false positives without opening exposure. Core: Networking & Security • Apply working command of TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, and NAT to keep messaging and identity reachable and secure. • Troubleshoot network-layer faults affecting mail flow, hybrid connectivity, and authentication end to end. • Apply network-security principles and integrate cleanly across messaging, identity, cloud, and the security stack. Core: Microsoft 365, Identity & Automation • Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Single Sign-On (SSO): tenant configuration, conditional access, and application registrations in coordination with Information Security. • Build and maintain PowerShell scripting and automation for provisioning, reporting, bulk operations, and repeatable runbooks. • Own monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, patching, and infrastructure documentation for the messaging and identity estate; keep runbooks and topology current. General • Provide senior-level escalation for messaging, identity, and email-security incidents raised by IT Team Leaders and the Service Desk. • Maintain up-to-date, formally registered technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and as-built diagrams. • Contribute to departmental KPI objectives set for the financial year. • Ensure IT policies, security standards, and change-management procedures are followed. • Perform other assignments as required. Business Continuity • Ensure the messaging and identity BC/DR plans adequately deliver the required recovery capability and meet business continuity requirements. • Maintain, test, and document DAG failover, AD recovery, and Exchange/M365 restore procedures on a periodic basis. • Communicate the implications of infrastructure changes that may impact the BCMS. • Participate in BC exercises; support the Business Impact Analysis for messaging and identity services. • Make recommendations, remove roadblocks, and report continuity risk to IT management. Working Arrangement (Onshore, Riyadh) • Base: Riyadh, with on-site and hybrid working arrangements in line with organisational policy. • Hours: Standard working hours, with flexibility to support business needs. • On-call: Participates in an on-call rotation for critical messaging, identity, and email-security incidents, including outside standard working hours, in line with agreed response targets. • Change windows: Executes major changes (upgrades, migrations, DAG/AD maintenance) inside approved maintenance windows, typically outside peak, with change-management sign-off. • Access & security: Follows applicable information security, data-handling, and privileged-access controls. Competencies: Professional and Technical Behavioral Competencies Competency Level Analytical Thinking Level 4 Initiative Level 3 Continuous Learning Level 3 Communication (written & verbal) Level 3 Stress Management Level 3 Planning & Organizing Level 3 Adaptability Level 3 Teamwork Level 3 Technical Competencies Competency Proficiency Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 (on-prem + hybrid, DAG) Expert Exchange migrations & mail flow / connectors / certificates Expert Active Directory & Group Policy (design, DR, replication) Expert DNS / DHCP / domain services Advanced Email security (gateway, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, anti-phishing) Advanced Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / SSO / Conditional Access Advanced PowerShell scripting & automation Advanced Networking & network security (TCP/IP, firewall, VPN, VLAN, NAT) Intermediate to Advanced Backup, DR, patching & infrastructure documentation Advanced Critical incident management Advanced Competencies: EHS Awareness of basic EHS requirements and corporate objectives; awareness of EHS/incident reporting within the QEHS management system. Organizational Competencies Intermediate. Refer to the organisation's applicable competency framework. Decision Making Decides and executes: messaging/identity configuration, patch and change execution within approved windows, migration cutover mechanics, GPO and email-security policy tuning, and automation design. Recommends and routes up: architecture changes, tenant-level identity/security policy, BC/DR strategy, and major-version platform decisions (to the relevant IT infrastructure and Information Security leadership). Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) • Maintain high availability of messaging services and prevent avoidable outages through timely certificate management and patching. • Respond to critical messaging and identity incidents within agreed targets, restore services promptly, and document root causes. • Mailbox migration waves delivered on schedule with zero data loss and a tested rollback per wave. • Keep systems patched in line with approved security baselines and remediate critical vulnerabilities within required timeframes. • Email security: SPF/DKIM/DMARC at enforcement; measured reduction in delivered phishing/spam with controlled false-positive rate. • Test business continuity and disaster recovery procedures periodically and document successful recovery tests. • Maintain current technical runbooks and infrastructure documentation for all owned services. • Meet the individual KPIs agreed for the current financial year. Level 3 Engineer of Microsoft Exchange 2019 and Exchange Server Subscription Edition. Have proven experience in installation and upgrade of Microsoft Exchange Environment-Expert. Hybrid environment Microsoft 365 ability to manage Microsoft Teams. Active Directory and understanding of Group Policies Qualification: E

With a global reach and network, we specialize in attracting high-potential professionals with sophisticated skills from various industries, including Oil & Gas, Petroleum, Infrastructure, Energy, Water, Transportation, Science & Technology, and Health Care. As a Control Room Operator, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of control systems within the oil and energy sector. Your responsibilities will include monitoring, operating, and maintaining control panels, systems, and equipment to regulate and optimize production processes. You will collaborate closely with technicians, engineers, and other team members to achieve operational excellence while adhering to safety guidelines and industry regulations. Bachelor’s degree in an IT, Electrical or Electronics Engineering or related discipline. 6-7 years of IT experience with at least 4 years Data Centres design, operation and maintenance experience. Data centre experience in the HPC field is a plus including working knowledge in servers, interconnects, cabling, and cooling techniques. Professional Data Centre certification is a plus (such as CDCP, CDCS, CDCDP). Project management certification is a plus (such as PMP or PRINCE 2).

f1f63b02068c4023.description: HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking a meticulous Civil Inspector to oversee civil construction activities and ensure compliance with design specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations. The Civil Inspector will play a crucial role in maintaining high-quality standards throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular inspections of civil works including foundations, structural elements, roadworks, and other infrastructure components. Verify that construction work complies with design drawings, specifications, and relevant codes. Identify and report any non-conformances, defects, or safety hazards. Coordinate with engineers, contractors, and site supervisors to resolve technical issues. Prepare and maintain detailed inspection reports and documentation. Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental standards on site. Support quality control processes and assist in testing activities. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering or a related field. Minimum of 7 years experience in civil construction inspection or quality control. Strong understanding of civil construction methods, materials, and standards. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications. Good communication and reporting skills. Experience working on large-scale infrastructure projects is preferred. Knowledge of local regulations and safety standards in Saudi Arabia is an advantage.

f1ee6922c2973607.description: Job Purpose The QHSSE Manager is responsible for overseeing all Quality, Health, Safety, Environmental & Security related aspects, within the complex/attractions. Including, conducting audits, delivering training, incident management & investigations, security personnel, managing access controls, conducting risk assessments, and coordinating with local authorities to maintain a secure and compliant environment for employees, guests, and assets. This role ensures that all QHSSE protocols and procedures are adhered to, and that any potential threats or incidents are managed effectively. The QHSSE Manager also supports compliance with QHSSE standards and contributes to a safe environment across the complex or attraction. Managerial Accountabilities: Strategy and Planning Implement the SEVEN QHSSE standards across the complex and attraction, aligning with the overall business objectives and QHSSE standards. Plan and coordinate security resource allocation, budgeting, and staffing to ensure effective coverage and operational efficiency. Set performance goals for the QHSSE team and monitor progress to achieve department objectives. Stakeholder Relations Act as the primary point of contact for QHSSE related matters with internal and external stakeholders, including local authorities and emergency services. Build and maintain strong relationships with law enforcement agencies and industry partners to enhance security collaboration and information sharing. Governance and Compliance Implement and monitor the SEVEN QHSSE policies and standards Monitor compliance with security policies and procedures, conducting audits and assessments to identify gaps and implement corrective actions. Budget Management Oversee the budgeting process for Complex/Attraction QHSSE operations, ensuring effective utilization of resources and alignment with financial targets. Monitor and control QHSSE related expenses, seeking opportunities to optimize costs and improve operational efficiency. Optimize resource allocation, including labor, inventory, and equipment, to maximize efficiency and minimize costs. People Management Lead employee performance management processes within the Complex QHSSE department, ensuring continuous improvement and development. Direct performance evaluation processes and validate results to ensure appropriate and fair evaluation of security personnel. Promote a culture of safety, integrity, and service excellence within the QHSSE team. Functional Accountabilities: Security Operations Management Lead and supervise security personnel, ensuring that all staff are trained, equipped, and capable of carrying out their duties effectively. Manage the performance of the appointed security third party within the attractions/complex Develop and implement security policies, procedures, and emergency response plans to protect employees, guests, and assets. Monitor access control systems, surveillance, and other security measures to prevent unauthorized access and mitigate security risks. Risk Assessment and Incident Management Conduct regular risk assessments to identify potential QHSSE threats, vulnerabilities, and areas for improvement within the complex or attraction. Manage incidents and emergencies, coordinating with local authorities and internal teams to ensure a swift and effective response. Prepare and maintain detailed incident reports, documenting all QHSSE breaches, investigations, and resolutions. Develop incident management reports for management submission Compliance and Coordination Ensure compliance with local regulations, QHSSE standards, and internal policies to maintain a safe and secure environment. Liaise with local law enforcement, emergency services, and regulatory authorities to build strong partnerships and support effective incident management. Manage audits and inspections, ensuring that all measures meet established standards and are operating effectively. Team Development and Training Develop and implement training programs for SEVEN employees, including security employees and attractions operation teams, focusing on skills development, emergency response, and compliance with QHSSE protocols. Ensure that security staff are familiar with the layout of the complex or attraction and can assist guests and employees as needed. Coordinate regular emergency drills within the complex, identify opportunities for improvement and provide reports Asset Protection and Loss Prevention Implement loss prevention strategies to protect company assets, inventory, and equipment from theft, vandalism, or misuse. Monitor and review security systems and processes to identify potential vulnerabilities and implement corrective actions. Support the Facility Management team in managing physical security systems such as CCTV, alarms, and access controls. Guest Experience Contribute to a positive guest experience by ensuring a safe and secure environment for all guests, employees, and stakeholders. Address guest inquiries or concerns related to safety & security with professionalism and efficiency, providing assistance as needed. Support the guest services team in managing crowd control, event security, and emergency response to maintain a safe and welcoming atmosphere. Knowledge: Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Health & Safety Management or Security Management, QHSE, or a related field is preferred. Professional training in security operations and incident management Professional Certifications Health & Safety Professional (OSHA/IOSH) Certification in Security Management (e.g., CPP, PSP) is preferred. First Aid and Emergency Response Certification Risk Management Required Experience: Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in QHSE/security management, with at least 3 years in a managerial role. Experience in managing QHSE/security operations for large complexes, attractions, or entertainment venues is highly desirable. Experience in ISO audit program, in particular, IS0 9001 or ISO 45001

f1e01d83b82b210a.job_title: SAP Project Manager / Solution Architect (8 Month)
f1e01d83b82b210a.description: We are looking for an experienced SAP Project Manager / Solution Architect to lead and oversee SAP cloud transformation projects. The ideal candidate should have strong SAP architecture knowledge, proven project management experience, and hands-on experience delivering SAP cloud implementations or migrations. Key Responsibilities: Lead end-to-end SAP cloud implementation, migration, and transformation projects. Define and oversee the overall SAP solution architecture in alignment with business and technical requirements. Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and deliverables. Work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, SAP consultants, and third-party vendors. Design scalable and secure SAP cloud solutions and ensure alignment with SAP best practices. Provide technical leadership and guidance throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure successful integration between SAP and other enterprise/cloud platforms. Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential issues and develop appropriate mitigation plans. Coordinate with SAP and cloud technology teams to ensure smooth implementation and go-live. Ensure project documentation, architecture documentation, and technical standards are maintained. Support presales activities, solution design, estimations, and client presentations when required. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in SAP , with significant experience in SAP implementation/transformation projects. Proven experience as an SAP Project Manager, SAP Solution Architect, or in a combined Project Manager / Solution Architect role . Strong experience with SAP Cloud solutions and cloud transformation projects . Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud and preferably SAP BTP. Strong understanding of SAP architecture, integrations, security, and cloud technologies. Experience managing complex SAP projects from planning through implementation and go-live. Excellent stakeholder and client management skills. Strong communication and leadership skills. Mandatory Certification: Valid SAP Cloud certification is mandatory. Candidate must hold a recognized and current SAP cloud certification , preferably related to SAP S/4HANA Cloud, SAP BTP, or SAP Cloud Architecture . The candidate must be able to provide a valid copy/certificate number as proof of certification . Preferred: SAP Activate certification. PMP or PRINCE2 certification. TOGAF or other enterprise architecture certification. Experience with SAP BTP, integrations, APIs, and cloud security. Experience working on large-scale SAP transformation programs.

f1dae237762dbb23.description: Jasara PMC is inviting expressions of interest (EOI) for the position of Safety & Security Manager - Sports Facilities. This critical role will oversee the development, implementation, and management of safety and security protocols specifically tailored for sports facilities. The ideal candidate will ensure a safe, secure, and compliant environment for athletes, staff, and spectators. We are partnering with a reputable institution to deliver high‑profile sports and recreational facilities in Riyadh. This initiative will create a state‑of‑the‑art, refurbished and upgraded complex designed to provide high‑quality accommodation and amenities for sport and leisure—aligned with the project’s primary objectives. The project team will apply proven project management and construction‑supervision expertise to ensure on‑time delivery, strict cost control, and adherence to the highest quality and safety standards. We seek an exceptional, collaborative team committed to excellence and ready to contribute the skills and dedication required to deliver this scheme successfully. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement comprehensive safety and security policies and procedures adapted to sports facilities. Conduct regular risk assessments and safety audits to identify potential hazards and vulnerabilities. Coordinate and lead emergency preparedness and response planning for sporting events and daily operations. Oversee access control, crowd management, and surveillance systems to ensure facility security. Provide training and awareness programs to staff and stakeholders on safety and security best practices. Collaborate with local law enforcement, emergency services, and regulatory bodies to ensure compliance and effective coordination. Investigate security incidents, accidents, or safety breaches and implement corrective actions. Monitor regulatory changes and industry standards related to sports facility safety and security, recommending necessary updates. Qualifications and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Safety Management, Security Management, Occupational Health, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in safety and security management, preferably with a focus on sports or entertainment facilities. Strong knowledge of safety regulations, security protocols, and risk management principles applicable to sports venues. Experience in emergency preparedness, crowd control, and incident response planning. Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Relevant professional certifications such as NEBOSH, CPP, or equivalent are highly desirable. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Arabic is an advantage. Competitive salary and benefits package Opportunity to work in a dynamic and growing organization. Be part of a collaborative and supportive team
